jobs.title: AI & Automation Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** AI \& Automation Implementation Specialist  

**Location:** Remote (US\-Based)  

**Compensation:** $42,000 USD / year  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

  

Automate the Unseen. Scale the Extraordinary.  

  

US Ghost Adventures brings America’s darkest histories to life across dozens of cities, iconic landmarks like the Lizzie Borden House, and unique e\-commerce drops. Behind the scenes, we’re automating routine admin tasks so our national operations run faster, smarter, and at scale.


We need a hungry, high\-execution AI \& Automation Implementation Specialist to map out workflows, hand clear specs to developers, and test low\-code systems until they run seamlessly. You don't need to be a full\-stack software engineer—just comfortable with low\-code tools, APIs, sharp organization, and a drive to build. For the right operator, this role offers direct exposure to scaling a fast\-growing brand.

**Your Role in the Story**

* **Streamline HR \& Guide Admin:** Build ATS and payroll automations, generate AI\-assisted guide onboarding materials, and maintain guide dashboards for performance feedback, scheduling, and instant tour coverage alerts.
* **Support Marketing \& Brand Reputation:** Set up automated workflows to monitor ad performance, track local Google Business Profiles, assist with influencer outreach, monitor brand sentiment, and schedule email/SMS triggers.
* **Assist Content Pipelines:** Help organize an AI\-assisted workflow for planning, routing, and publishing social media and website content across our sub\-brands.
* **Map Workflows \& Write Specs:** Review existing manual tasks, write straightforward steps for our developer, establish basic operational rules, and thoroughly test automations before launch.
* **Drive Team Adoption:** Walk internal teams through new automated tools, track time/error reductions, and maintain strict human\-in\-the\-loop safeguards for sensitive HR, financial, and customer communications.

**The Toolkit You Bring**

* **Automation Tool Aptitude:** Direct experience or high comfort building with automation platforms like Zapier, Make, n8n, or no\-code AI platforms.
* **Process \& Task Mastery:** Exceptional organizational skills with a knack for breaking down messy routines into simple, step\-by\-step digital workflows.
* **Clear Technical Communication:** Ability to communicate clearly with developers about integrations, APIs, and business logic without needing to write full\-stack code yourself.
* **General Digital Savvy:** Basic familiarity with standard marketing tools (Ads, SEO, CRM) and HR/scheduling platforms (BambooHR or similar).
* **Builder Mindset:** A proactive operator who thrives on getting things done, learning new tech quickly, and taking full ownership of project deadlines.


Ready to Power Our Next Chapter?  

Skip the formal cover letter—just submit your resume. If you have portfolio links, project screenshots, or live examples of automations you’ve built, feel free to include them directly inside your resume file!

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Travel Expense & Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Join a dynamic team at the forefront of payment, expense, and invoice innovation. At Chase Travel Consulting Services, we empower our clients with strategic solutions and ongoing support, helping them optimize their financial operations and achieve their business goals. If you are ambitious and resourceful, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.


As a Senior Consultant within Chase Travel Consulting Services, you will serve as a trusted advisor to Chase Travel's premier clients, leading Concur Expense and Invoice implementations and helping organizations modernize their travel and expense programs. You will guide clients through the full implementation lifecycle, including process assessment, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, training, and post\-go\-live support. Working closely with client stakeholders and implementation teams, you will leverage your Concur expertise to deliver scalable solutions, drive user adoption, optimize business processes, and support successful organizational change.


Established as TCG Consulting, Chase Travel Consulting Services offers a suite of flexible services to bring organization's travel program to the next level. Our decades of experience combined with our patented TCO\-TMPE® approach enable organizations to achieve scalable alignment to broader company goals. Operationally, the Total Cost of Ownership for Travel, Meetings, Payment \& Expense approach enables increased spend under management, capturing all sources of program cost and yielding scalable savings and revenue opportunities.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with clients \& other departments to craft domestic or global functional design requirements and translate these into application solutions
* Translate and communicate client technical product needs to internal and external partners
* Advise clients on best practices and industry standards. Ability to “sell” clients on best practice standards during design phases
* Evaluate client business processes to determine ideal services and/or support required
* Recognize business process inefficiencies and provide recommendations for improvements
* Assist client with communication plans and training materials
* Conduct and validate process and needs assessments to perform tailored and effective product demonstrations either remotely or on\-site at a prospect's location
* Configure new software implementations or optimization changes
* Assist with responses to requests for proposals (RFP's)
* Travel onsite to clients as requested




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Bachelor's degree (or higher degree) required with emphasis on financial analysis, accounting, computer science, business analysis or similar field or equivalent work experience
* Demonstrated experience leading or supporting Concur implementations, with additional experience in expense processing, accounts payable, consulting, or other Expense Management Systems (EMS) such as Emburse, Brex, Ramp, Navan, Coupa, Workday, or Oracle.
* Project Management experience specifically on implementation teams
* Proven track record of delivering results and practical project management techniques
* Working knowledge of various expense management systems (Concur, Emburse, Brex, Ramp, Navan, Coupa, Workday, Oracle)
* Working knowledge of various invoice management systems (Ariba, Concur, Emburse, Coupa)
* Well organized, highly motivated, process driven and results\-oriented with the ability to balance priorities, work under pressure and assume responsibility in a multi\-tasking environment
* Ability to work independently, capable of handling multiple projects, and deadlines simultaneously
* Strong interpersonal, customer service, and written and verbal communication skills
* Effective and efficient skills using Microsoft Office tools especially Word, Excel, PowerPoint
* Proficiency and experience reviewing, analyzing, and reconciling data with a strong attention to detail




**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Successfully manage competing priorities and expectations
* Ability to quickly adapt to changing ideas and priorities
* Strong self\-direction in managing day\-to\-day priorities and assisting Associates in required daily tasks
* Strong sense of project ownership and time management
* Able to multi\-task as needed to meet daily work and project deadline
* Able to reach beyond internal networks to expand and leverage industry data and insights
* Flexible work environment to adapt to global client requirements




**Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the US. We are not able to provide immigration sponsorship or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. Final job grade level and corporate title will be determined at time of offer and may differ from this posting.**




FEDERAL DEPOSIT INSURANCE ACT: This position is subject to Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMorganChase's review of criminal conviction history, including pretrial diversions or program entries.


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.


We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission\-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on\-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.


We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.


Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.  

  

We offer a broad array of credit cards to meet the needs of individuals and small businesses, including Chase\-branded and co\-branded cards in partnership with well\-known companies and organizations. Merchant Services is a leading provider of payment, fraud and data security for companies, capable of authorizing transactions across global currencies.

jobs.title: Software Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
Onboarding Specialist

**Location:** Remote


**Employment type:** Full\-time


**Reports to:** Director of Operations

**About the Company:**


Saba Healthcare is a leading SNF operator that has launched a software subsidiary to help post\-acute care organizations improve the way they manage admissions and day\-to\-day workflows. Our customers rely on us to make complex processes easier to manage, easier to measure, and easier for their teams to adopt.

**About the role:**


The Onboarding Specialist will guide new customers from signed agreement through successful adoption. You will learn each customer’s workflow, help configure the platform, coordinate integrations, train users, monitor early usage, and stay engaged after launch to make sure teams are getting value from the product.


This is a customer\-facing, hands\-on role. You will work closely with customer leaders, admissions teams, technical contacts, and our product and engineering teams. The best person for this role is someone that has SNF admissions experience, and is organized, patient, technically curious, comfortable leading training, and able to follow through on details until the customer is truly up and running.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own onboarding projects from kickoff through launch and early adoption.
* Lead discovery sessions to understand customer goals, current processes, systems, users, and success criteria.
* Document customer workflows and translate them into clear configuration and implementation plans.
* Coordinate setup of customer accounts, permissions, workflows, templates, data, and integrations.
* Work with customer IT contacts and our technical teams to troubleshoot connectivity, data exchange, configuration, and workflow issues.
* Create practical implementation timelines, task lists, meeting notes, risk logs, and launch\-readiness checklists.
* Deliver live and recorded training for admissions, clinical, administrative, and leadership users.
* Adapt training to different levels of technical comfort and different customer workflows.
* Follow up consistently with customer teams after training and launch to reinforce adoption and resolve friction.
* Monitor usage, identify gaps, and recommend additional training, configuration changes, or process improvements.
* Maintain accurate customer documentation and communicate status clearly to internal stakeholders.
* Capture customer feedback and recurring issues so product and engineering can improve the platform.
* Help create repeatable onboarding playbooks, training materials, FAQs, and internal procedures as the company grows.

**What success looks like:**

* Customers launch on schedule with clear expectations and minimal avoidable friction.
* Users understand the workflows relevant to their jobs and can perform them confidently.
* Integrations, permissions, configurations, and training requirements are documented and completed accurately.
* Customer adoption continues after go\-live rather than dropping off after initial training.
* Risks and unresolved issues are surfaced early and tracked to closure.
* Each onboarding produces useful feedback that improves the next onboarding.

**Required qualifications:**

* 2\+ years of experience working in skilled nursing admissions, using referral, admissions, EHR, or related healthcare software.
* Experience managing multiple projects, customers, or workstreams at the same time.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort leading meetings and training sessions with both frontline users and executives.
* Strong organization, follow\-through, and attention to detail.
* Technical confidence with web applications, user permissions, data imports, integrations, spreadsheets, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to explain unfamiliar technical concepts in clear, practical language.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while keeping internal and customer stakeholders informed.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Direct experience with admissions, referrals, insurance verification, authorizations, clinical documentation, or census workflows.
* Experience implementing healthcare software or working with EHRs, referral portals, APIs, eFax, or similar systems.
* Experience creating training programs, standard operating procedures, or customer\-facing documentation.

jobs.title: RHTP Primary Care Implementation Specialist - Temporary
jobs.description:
**Let’s do great things, together!**


**About Moda**  

Founded in Oregon in 1955, Moda is proud to be a company of real people committed to quality. Today, like then, we’re focused on building a better future for healthcare. That starts by offering outstanding coverage to our members, compassionate support to our community and comprehensive benefits to our employees. It keeps going by connecting with neighbors to create healthy spaces and places, together. Moda values diversity and inclusion in our workplace. We aim to demonstrate our commitment to diversity through all our business practices and invite applications from candidates that share our commitment to this diversity. Our diverse experiences and perspectives help us become a stronger organization. Let’s be better together.

  

**Position Summary**



The RHTP Primary Care Implementation Specialist serves as a key liaison between Moda Health and partners at rural hospital\-based primary care clinics on Alaska’s Kenai Peninsula. This role provides technical assistance, subject matter expertise, and project management oversight to advance value\-based payment (VBP) readiness through the National Committee on Quality Assurance (NCQA) Primary Care Medical Home (PCMH) implementation. The position partners with hospital and clinic stakeholders to implement a robust quality improvement and data reporting infrastructure to enable quality measure reporting, support population health management, and prepare clinics for sustainable VBP participation through the NCQA PCMH model.



This is a full\-time position. The ideal candidate will reside in Alaska’s Anchorage/Kenai Peninsula region. *This is a limited duration position contingent on continued receipt of RHTP grant funds.*

  


**Pay Range**



$85,000 \- $87,318\.58 annually (depending on experience)  

Actual pay is based on qualifications. Applicants who do not exceed the minimum qualifications will only be eligible for the low end of the pay range.

  

**Please fill out an application on our company page, linked below, to be considered for this position.**



https://j.brt.mv/jb.do?reqGK\=27785428\&refresh\=true  

  

**Benefits****:**


* Medical, Dental, Vision \& Pharmacy
* PTO and Company Paid Holidays
* 401k \- Matching

  

  

**Required Skills, Experience \& Education:**



* Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Public Health, Public Policy, or Healthcare Administration\-related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.


* 3 \- 5 years of experience working in healthcare, public health, or health\-related community\-based organizations. Experience working in or with rural or underserved communities preferred.


* Familiarity with NCQA PCMH and/or Oregon’s Patient\-Centered Primary Care Home requirements and recognition processes.


* Demonstrated understanding of value\-based payment (VBP) systems and APMs in healthcare settings.


* Knowledge of primary care clinic functions such as case management/care coordination, use of electronic health record (EHR) systems, population health\-level metrics and reporting, behavioral health integration, and collaboration with Traditional Health Workers (THWs).


* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially MS Excel and other reporting software.


* Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience convening diverse stakeholders and facilitating productive virtual and in\-person meetings.


* Ability to manage complex projects, track activities, and meet short and long\-term project milestones.


* Ability to maintain confidentiality and project a professional business image.
  


**Primary Functions****:**



* Serve as subject matter expert to partner hospital organization leadership on all matters related to PCMH recognition and Alternative Payment Model (APM) design and implementation.


* Regularly meet with steering committee composed of executive leadership from both Alaska hospitals, Moda Health subject matter experts, and statewide policy partners to guide PCMH implementation, resolve barriers, and ensure shared ownership of key decisions.


* Use project management skills to create and maintain detailed implementation plan and task trackers across multiple stakeholder organizations.


* Provide technical assistance to partner organizations, enabling achievement of core and elective criteria for PCMH recognition across the concepts of team\-based care and practice organization, knowing and managing patients, patient\-centered access, care management and support, care coordination and transitions, performance measurement and quality improvement, and behavioral health integration.


* Partner closely with Medicaid Quality and Innovation Manager, Grants Management Specialist, and Medicaid Quality Supervisor to support clinical partners in meeting RHTP requirements and timeline.


* Use independent judgment to make key business decisions and provide informed recommendations on PCMH criteria implementation and APM design to partner organizations and Moda Health senior leadership.


* Perform other duties as assigned.
  



Working Conditions \& Contact with Others:


* Office environment with extensive close PC and keyboard use, constant sitting, and frequent phone communication. Must be able to navigate multiple computer screens. A reliable, high\-speed, hard\-wired internet connection required to support remote or hybrid work. Must be comfortable being on camera for virtual training and meetings. Work in excess of standard workweek, including evenings and occasional weekends, to meet business need. Occasional and overnight travel may be required.
* Internally with all Moda departments. Externally with partner healthcare organizations and vendors.
